title: backgroundThrottling heavily throttles web worker messages
body:

### Electron Version

41.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

14.8.3

### What arch are you using?

arm64 (including Apple Silicon)

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

`backgroundThrottling: true` should throttle messages between web worker and window not more than a few seconds. 

### Actual Behavior

Messages from web worker to window are throttled for over 12 seconds, resulting in a burst of messages on window focus. 

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

I have tried `app.commandLine.appendSwitch('disable-background-timer-throttling')` to no avail.
